statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-63520, the Microsoft SharePoint Business Connectivity Services remote code execution flaw that completes the chain with CVE-2026-55040, to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-08-27 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry for CVE-2026-63520 whose dateAdded value falls between 2026-08-27 and 2026-09-30 inclusive; otherwise false.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog carries no entry for CVE-2026-63520, or the entry has a dateAdded outside 2026-08-27 through 2026-09-30.
